about.desc: Hi, I'm Zuzlifatul Adnan — a Full-Stack Developer based in Lampung with 4+ years of experience building custom websites, admin dashboards, and mobile apps. My clients range from SMEs and schools to local government agencies across Indonesia.
about.desc2: I handle projects end-to-end — from requirement consultation and architecture design, through development with weekly demos, to deployment and post-launch support. Every project is built production-ready from day one, with clean, maintainable code that your team can scale.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.note: Everything you need to know before we start working together.

q1.q: How long does a typical project take?
q1.a: Most websites take 2–6 weeks. Mobile apps and complex dashboards usually take 6–12 weeks. You'll get a clear timeline after the discovery call.

q2.q: Do you work remotely or on-site?
q2.a: I work fully remote with clients across Indonesia and overseas. On-site visits are possible within Lampung if required.

q3.a: Design, development, hosting setup, deployment, training, source code, and 30 days of post-launch support. No hidden fees.

q4.q: Do I own the source code?
q4.a: Yes. You get full ownership of the code and all assets upon final payment, including the GitHub/GitLab repository.

q5.q: How do we communicate during the project?
q5.a: WhatsApp for quick chats, email for formal updates, and weekly demo calls. You can reach me any business day.
